input.change_text: [VSCode] Fixed "Manage Plugins" panel breaking when multiple large marketplaces are configured

output.subject: VSCode `Manage Plugins` panel no longer breaks with multiple large marketplaces
output.action_text: Upgrade Claude Code to 2.1.117 in VSCode if you configure multiple large plugin marketplaces. Pre-fix, the `Manage Plugins` panel would break and become unusable; the fix restores normal panel behavior at scale.
